_comment: Machine-readable extract of Choi, Lee et al. 2020 (Cell Stem Cell), roadmap paper 2, Gate 1. Every marker set and claim here was read from the Europe PMC full-text XML, which preserves the italicised gene symbols that the PMC web rendering strips; a note built from that rendering would have had empty marker lists. Nothing here is a result of this repository.

citation.authors: Choi J, Park J-E, Tsagkogeorga G, Yanagita M, Koo B-K, Han N, Lee J-H
citation.title: Inflammatory signals induce AT2 cell-derived damage-associated transient progenitors that mediate alveolar regeneration

roadmap.role: biological spine: IL-1beta and HIF1alpha drive the AT2 to DATP to AT1 transition; chronic inflammation can stall regeneration
roadmap.why_it_matters_here: it defines the DATP state that roadmap paper 5 carries into tumour initiation, and its first author leads one of the target labs

injury_model.injury: bleomycin, against PBS as the homeostatic control

states_resolved.note: the same five states are reported in the in vivo lineage-labelled data and in the organoid data

marker_sets.DATP_negative_condition_note: DATPs share the AT1-lineage signature but carry much lower canonical AT1 markers; the low condition is part of the definition, not an afterthought
marker_sets.primed_AT2_note: these are DOWN in primed AT2 cells; the state is defined by loss of AT2 identity rather than by a positive marker

cascade_as_stated: bleomycin expands interstitial macrophages at day 7 while alveolar macrophages fall; both return to homeostatic levels by day 28
interstitial-macrophage-derived IL-1beta acts on the Il1r1-expressing subset of AT2 cells
those cells lose AT2 identity and become primed AT2 cells
primed AT2 cells convert into DATPs
the conversion runs through HIF1alpha-driven glycolysis, and blocking it blocks AT1 differentiation
DATPs differentiate into mature AT1 cells, established by lineage tracing
persistent IL-1beta prevents AT1 maturation, DATPs accumulate, and regeneration is impaired

evidence_class_per_link.DATPs sit between primed AT2 and AT1 in: PAGA plus diffusion pseudotime; reusable, and needs no replication because it is an ordering inside a library
evidence_class_per_link.DATPs derive from AT2 cells: lineage tracing, about 10 percent of labelled cells Krt8-positive at day 14; NOT reusable from transcriptomes
evidence_class_per_link.DATPs become AT1 cells: lineage tracing from an Ndrg1 driver; NOT reusable
evidence_class_per_link.IL-1beta is sufficient to make DATPs: organoids plus imaging and flow; the state change is re-derivable, the sufficiency claim is not
evidence_class_per_link.only Il1r1-positive AT2 cells respond: Il1r1 reporter mice, functional and epigenetic; NOT reusable, and the ATAC deposit cannot help
evidence_class_per_link.HIF1alpha glycolysis is required: extracellular acidification, glucose uptake, digoxin, conditional deletion; the gene expression is re-derivable, the requirement is not
evidence_class_per_link.interstitial macrophages are the IL-1bet: flow cytometry; NOT reusable, the deposit sorts epithelium only
evidence_class_per_link.chronic IL-1beta stalls AT1 maturation: prolonged exposure in vivo and in organoids; NOT reusable

deposited_data.design: three time points (PBS, day 14, day 28) by two sorts (Tomato-positive lineage-labelled, Tomato-negative)
deposited_data.does_not_support: any tested contrast between time points

deposited_data.supports: the direction of the state change under IL-1beta

deposited_data.libraries: 2 files deposited as bigwig coverage tracks only
deposited_data.supports: almost nothing; coverage carries neither peaks nor reads
deposited_data.does_not_support: re-derivation of the epigenetic claim without going to SRA for raw reads

their_pipeline.doublets: no dedicated caller; cells removed by prior-knowledge implausibility and higher UMI count
their_pipeline.trajectory: converted to Scanpy 1.3.6, k-nearest neighbours recomputed at k = 15, PAGA for topology, diffusion pseudotime with default parameters
their_pipeline.imaging: ImageJ on Leica TCS SP5 confocal sections, at least five sections and ten alveolar regions from three mice per group

constraints_carried_into_this_repository: One library per condition in both single-cell accessions, so no transcriptomic contrast here carries within-group replication. Directions are describable; nothing between conditions is testable; no P value is admissible on a between-condition comparison.
Trajectory ordering is the exception: an ordering inside a single library does not need between-group replication, so the AT2 to primed AT2 to DATP to AT1 sequence is genuinely re-askable.

Several imaging quantifications plot one dot per histological section with three to six mice per group. Where the dot is a section the plotted unit is not the animal, and this repository treats sections from one animal as technical replicates. Re-read any reused figure for what its n refers to before quoting it as a per-animal effect.
The ATAC-seq supplementary files are bigwig coverage only, so the epigenetic half of the Il1r1-subset claim cannot be re-derived from the deposit at all.
The DATP definition includes a negative condition (low Pdpn, Hopx, Cav1). A marker score built from the positive genes alone will not separate DATPs from mature AT1 cells.

The primed AT2 state is defined by loss of Etv5, Abca3 and Cebpa rather than by a positive marker, so it cannot be scored the same way as the other states and a score_genes call on it will behave differently.
Ndrg1 appears in both the DATP marker set and the hypoxia programme, so it cannot be used as independent evidence for both the state and its mechanism.
The Tomato-negative libraries are a within-animal control worth using: they are the cells the AT2 lineage did not label, from the same lung and the same dissociation.
